async homeassistant.components.hue.v1.light.async_setup_platform(hass, config, async_add_entities, discovery_info=None)[source]

Old way of setting up Hue lights.

Can only be called when a user accidentally mentions hue platform in their config. But even in that case it would have been ignored.
